plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Howard McNear is credited on 648 distinct recordings across 37 programs from 1937-01-25 through 1961-06-18. Documented roles include performer on 647 recordings and commercial spokesman on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Gunsmoke (performer on 361 recordings; 361 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 84 recordings; 84 distinct recordings), The Line Up (performer on 45 recordings; 45 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 31 recordings; 31 distinct recordings), Broadway Is My Beat (performer on 15 recordings; 15 distinct recordings), Wild Bill Hickok (performer on 11 recordings; 11 distinct recordings), The Six Shooter (performer on 9 recordings; 9 distinct recordings), and The Adventures of Philip Marlowe (performer on 8 recordings; 8 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Doc Adams (361 portrayals) and Pliny (5 portrayals).
